file_insights.purpose: Performance benchmarking for BM25 search indexing and operations
key_components: BM25Index wrapper with graceful import fallback
Document generation with diverse topics for realistic testing
Custom Logger class for consistent output formatting
CLI argument parsing with dry-run and output options

patterns_discovered.description: Uses try-except blocks and conditional fallbacks to handle missing dependencies (loguru, rank-bm25). Creates mock modules when dependencies unavailable.
patterns_discovered.evidence: Lines 23-44 show import wrapping with loguru mock fallback; lines 260-265 check for rank-bm25

patterns_discovered.description: Uses importlib.util to load BM25Index module directly, avoiding package __init__.py side effects
Supports --dry-run flag to test script structure without executing actual operations
patterns_discovered.evidence: Lines 150-156 return dummy data when dry_run=True

patterns_discovered.description: Uses time.perf_counter() throughout for high-precision timing, applied consistently to generation, indexing, and search operations
Generates diverse document topics to simulate realistic BM25 behavior across different content domains
patterns_discovered.evidence: Lines 85-98 define 10 distinct topics covering finance, ML, legal, recipes, travel, etc.

gotchas_discovered.description: Script requires both loguru and rank-bm25 packages. Missing either breaks normal operation, necessitating careful error messaging and dry-run fallback.
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Dry-run mode and clear error messages guide users to install dependencies

gotchas_discovered.description: Direct package import can trigger unwanted __init__.py behavior. Requires importlib workaround to load BM25Index directly.
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Uses spec_from_file_location to load module without executing package initialization

gotchas_discovered.description: loguru may not be available, but used by BM25Index. Simple mock required to avoid AttributeError.
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Creates minimal loguru mock with SimpleNamespace if import fails

gotchas_discovered.description: Search time measurements vary significantly; max/min values needed for meaningful benchmark variance reporting
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Tracks search_time_min and search_time_max alongside average

key_achievements: Comprehensive BM25 benchmark script with multiple corpus sizes
Robust error handling for missing dependencies
JSON output format for machine-readable results
Realistic document generation with diverse topics
